g.title: J_DEP_ANT
g.text: EPS board: antenna burn driver (ANTENNA_BURN), sense to OBC PB11 via W3

g.title: W7A
g.text: Burn pairs twisted; 1 A derated needs 24 AWG (SQSO-HAR-001 5.2). Sense pair 28 AWG would do

g.title: ANT
g.text: Nichrome or resistor burn, about 5 Ohm (TBR); microswitch per element, closed when deployed

g.title: J_DEP_SA
g.text: EPS board: solar burn driver (SOLAR_BURN), sense to OBC PB12 via W3

g.title: W7B
g.text: Length TBD with the wing layout

g.title: WING
g.text: Burn resistor per wing; hinge-side microswitch per wing
